_comment: Mood presets for prosody control. Applied to sections of entries based on content.

cozy.description: Warm bedtime story pace. Used for introductions, reflections, and 'What We Learned' sections.

tense.description: Something's wrong. Used for bug discoveries, production incidents, 'Then we found...' moments.

urgent.description: Crisis mode. Used for disk full, 500 errors, deploy failures.

triumphant.description: We fixed it. Used for resolution moments, 'It worked. It finally worked.'

reflective.description: Looking back. Used for lessons learned, CTO self-assessment, closing paragraphs.

matter-of-fact.description: Neutral delivery. Used for technical explanations, numbered lists, code walkthrough narration.

dramatic.description: Building tension. Used for 'But Wait, There's More' and reveal moments.

section_hints._comment: Hints for the SSML generator to auto-assign moods based on heading text or content patterns.
